structure.title: [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#what-is-stscript)什么是STscript？
structure.prefix_summary: Explains that STscript is a lightweight yet powerful scripting language built into SillyTavern, enabling users to extend functionality without heavy coding, for tasks like custom mini-games, AI chat insights, and creativity sharing. Notes it’s built on the slash-command engine (with command batching, data pipelines, macros, and variables), and highlights that STscript is still in active development with staging branch recommended for new features.

structure.prefix_summary:
## [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#user-input)用户输入

现在让我们在脚本中添加一点交互性。我们将接受用户的输入值并将其显示在通知中。

```python
/input Enter your name |
/echo Hello, my name is {{pipe}}
```

1. 该命令用于显示一个输入框，其中包含在未命名参数中指定的提示符，然后将输出写入管道。`/input`

1. 由于已经有一个未命名的参数来设置输出的模板，因此我们使用宏来指定将呈现管道值的位置。`/echo{{pipe}}`

structure.title: [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#flow-control---conditionals)流量控制 - 条件
structure.prefix_summary:
## [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#flow-control---conditionals)流量控制 - 条件

您可以使用该命令创建条件表达式，这些表达式根据定义的规则对执行进行分支。`/if`

`/if left=valueA right=valueB rule=comparison else="(command on false)" "(command on true)"`

让我们回顾一下以下示例：

```python
/input What's your favorite drink? |
/if left={{pipe}} right="black tea" rule=eq else="/echo You shall not pass \| /abort" "/echo Welcome to the club, \{\{user\}\}"
```

此脚本根据所需值评估用户输入，并根据输入值显示不同的消息。

nodes.title: [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#subcommands)子命令
nodes.summary: The document section explains how to use subcommands in SillyTavern scripts: use escaped separators (`\|`) for command batching within subcommands, escape macros as `\{\{\macro\}\}` to defer evaluation until subcommand execution, note results of subcommands feed into following `/if` command, and that the `/abort` command stops the script. It also shows `/if` acting as a ternary operator, providing a `/pass` example that outputs “true” or “false” based on a variable comparison.

structure.title: [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#flow-control---loops)流量控制 - 回路
structure.prefix_summary:
## [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#flow-control---loops)流量控制 - 回路

如果需要在循环中运行某些命令，直到满足特定条件，请使用该命令。`/while`

`/while left=valueA right=valueB rule=operation guard=on "commands"`

在循环的每个步骤中，它将变量 A 的值与变量 B 的值进行比较，如果条件产生 true，则执行任何用引号括起来的有效斜杠命令，否则循环存在。此命令不会将任何内容写入输出管道。

nodes.title: [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#arguments-for-while)`/while` 的参数
nodes.summary: Explains `/while` command: arguments same as `/if`; guard parameter to limit iterations 100 prior infinite loops disable guard=off; example increments variable i from 0 to 10 using /setvar, /while with rule lt, /addvar, /echo, /flushvar.

nodes.title: [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#arguments-for-times)`/times` 的参数
nodes.summary:
### [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#arguments-for-times)`/times` 的参数

运行子命令指定次数。

`/times (repeats) "(command)"`– 任何用引号括起来的有效斜杠命令都会重复多次，例如 将 1 加到“i”的值上 5 次。`/setvar key=i 1 | /times 5 "/addvar key=i 1"`

- {{timesIndex}} 替换为迭代数（从零开始），例如 呼应数字 0 到 4。`/times 4 "/echo {{timesIndex}}"`

- 默认情况下，循环限制为 100 次迭代，传递到禁用。`guard=off`

nodes.title: [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#example-1-get-an-area-of-a-circle-with-a-radius-of-50)示例 1：获取半径为 50 的圆的面积。
nodes.summary:
### [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#example-1-get-an-area-of-a-circle-with-a-radius-of-50)示例 1：获取半径为 50 的圆的面积。

```python
/setglobalvar key=PI 3.1415 |
/setvar key=r 50 |
/mul r r PI |
/round |
/echo Circle area: {{pipe}}
```

nodes.title: [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#example-2-calculate-a-factorial-of-5)示例 2：计算 5 的阶乘。
nodes.summary:
### [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#example-2-calculate-a-factorial-of-5)示例 2：计算 5 的阶乘。

```python
/setvar key=input 5 |
/setvar key=i 1 |
/setvar key=product 1 |
/while left=i right=input rule=lte "/mul product i \| /setvar key=product \| /addvar key=i 1" |
/getvar product |
/echo Factorial of {{getvar::input}}: {{pipe}} |
/flushvar input |
/flushvar i |
/flushvar product
```

structure.title: [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#using-the-llm)使用 LLM
structure.prefix_summary:
## [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#using-the-llm)使用 LLM

脚本可以使用以下命令向当前连接的 LLM API 发出请求：

- `/gen (prompt)`— 使用所选字符的提示生成文本，并包括聊天消息。

- `/genraw (prompt)`— 仅使用提供的提示生成文本，忽略当前字符和聊天。

- `/trigger`— 触发正常生成（相当于单击“发送”按钮）。如果在群聊中，您可以选择提供从 1 开始的群成员索引或角色名称来让他们回复，否则会根据群组设置触发群组回合。

nodes.summary:
### [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#arguments-for-trimtokens)`/trimtokens` 的参数

`/trimtokens limit=number direction=start/end (input)`

1. `direction`设置修剪方向，可以是 或 。违约：。`startendend`

1. `limit`将令牌的数量设置为输出中的左边。还可以指定包含数字的变量名称。**必需参数。**

1. 未命名参数是要修剪的输入文本。

1. `list`是包含候选项的字符串的 JSON 序列化数组。还可以指定包含列表的变量名称。**必需参数。**

nodes.title: [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#manual-execution)手动执行
nodes.summary:
### [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#manual-execution)手动执行

现在，您可以将第一个脚本添加到库中。选择任何空闲插槽（或创建一个），在左侧框中键入“单击我”以设置标签，然后将其粘贴到右侧框中：

```python
/addvar key=clicks 1 |
/if left=clicks right=5 rule=eq else="/echo Keep going..." "/echo You did it!  \| /flushvar clicks"
```

然后在聊天栏上方出现的按钮上单击 5 次。每次单击都会将变量递增 1，并在值等于 5 时显示不同的消息并重置变量。`clicks`

nodes.summary:
### [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#calling-procedures-from-a-different-quick-reply-preset)Calling procedures from a different Quick Reply preset

You can call a procedure from a different quick reply preset using the syntax, where a = QR preset name and b = QR label name`a.b`

`/run QRpreset1.QRlabel1`

By default, the system will first look for a quick reply label , so if one of your labels is literally "QRpreset1.QRlabel1" it will try to run that. If no such label is found, it will search for a QR preset name "QRpreset1" with a QR labelled "QRlabel1".`a.b`

nodes.summary:
#### [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#create-or-update-qr-preset)Create or update QR preset

- `/qr-presetupdate (arguments [label])` or `/qr-presetadd (arguments [label])`

Arguments:

- `enabled` - bool - enable or disable the preset

- `nosend` - bool - disable send / insert in user input (invalid for slash commands)

- `before` - bool - place QR before user input

- `slots` - int - number of slots

- `inject` - bool - inject user input automatically (if disabled use `{{input}}`)

Create a new preset (overrides existing ones), example: `/qr-presetadd slots=3 MyNewPreset`

structure.prefix_summary:
## [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#ui-interaction)UI interaction

Scripts can also interact with SillyTavern's UI: navigate through the chats or change styling parameters.

nodes.title: [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#character-navigation)Character navigation
nodes.summary:
### [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#character-navigation)Character navigation

1. `/random` — opens a chat with the random character.

1. `/go (name)` — opens a chat with the character of the specified name. First, searches for the exact name match, then by a prefix, then by a substring.

nodes.title: [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#ui-styling)UI styling
nodes.summary:
### [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#ui-styling)UI styling

1. `/bubble` — sets the message style to the "bubble chat" style.

1. `/flat` — sets the message style to the "flat chat" style.

1. `/single` — sets the message style to the "single document" style.

1. `/movingui (name)` — activates a MovingUI preset by name.

1. `/resetui` — resets the MovingUI panels state to their original positions.

1. `/panels` — toggles the UI panels visibility: top bar, left and right drawers.

1. `/bg (name)` — finds and sets a background using fuzzy names matching. Respect the chat background lock state.

1. `/lockbg` — locks the background image for the current chat.

1. `/unlockbg` — unlocks the background image for the current chat.

nodes.title: [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#generate-chat-summary-by-ikaridevgit)生成聊天摘要（按@IkariDevGIT）
nodes.summary: Describes a script workflow for creating a chat summary (attributed to IkariDev) in SillyTavern ST-Script: it sets a global summary prompt, captures chat messages up to last message, trims tokens, stores the content, generates a summary via `/genraw`, then reports completion and cleans up temporary variables.

nodes.title: [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#buttons-popup-usage)按钮弹出窗口用法
nodes.summary:
### [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#buttons-popup-usage)按钮弹出窗口用法

```python
/setglobalvar key=genders ["boy", "girl", "other"] |
/buttons labels=genders Who are you? |
/echo You picked: {{pipe}}
```

nodes.title: [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#get-nth-fibonaccis-number-using-binets-formula)获取第 N 个斐波那契数（使用 Binet 公式）
nodes.summary:
### [#](https://docs.sillytavern.app/usage/st-script/#get-nth-fibonaccis-number-using-binets-formula)获取第 N 个斐波那契数（使用 Binet 公式）


**提示**：将值设置为所需数字`fib_no`

```python
/setvar key=fib_no 5 |
/pow 5 0.5 | /setglobalvar key=SQRT5 |
/setglobalvar key=PHI 1.618033 |
/pow PHI fib_no | /div {{pipe}} SQRT5 |
/round |
/echo {{getvar::fib_no}}th Fibonacci's number is: {{pipe}}
```
